sources.title: grpo_qlora.ipynb - Colab
sources.snippet: Key concepts GRPO: A reinforcement learning algorithm that optimizes a policy by comparing multiple generated responses for the same prompt and updating the model based on their relative rewards, without requiring a separate value model. LoRA: Updates only a few low-rank parameters, reducing training cost and memory.
